known_limitations.detail: The current local sample/demo consolidation requires canonical repository validation on the current source.
Detection runtime source changed after the retained CUDA evidence. A fresh production-service probe is required before current runtime qualification can be claimed.
Bayes-PFL localizes anomalies but emits the native generic type anomaly rather than a semantic defect subtype.
The fixed 0.72 map threshold, component-area filter, and bbox padding are application adapter settings rather than an upstream accuracy claim.
The upstream Bayes-PFL repository states MIT licensing, but the distributed train_visa.pth checkpoint does not carry a separately stated binary license in tracked source metadata.
Python API/detection/storage tests, frontend tests, validators, and a production build are present; full browser end-to-end automation is not part of repository checks.
